name: Palma del Río (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over dark blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Palma del Río (a palm tree on blue above waves within an inscribed bordure).
history: Municipal flag of Palma del Río; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Palma del Río arms — palm tree above waves within an inscribed bordure
